instruction: Please enable the 'Allow only one instance' option in VLC when opening files from the file manager. I prefer having all media files open in a single VLC window.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
